scripts.watch: cargo watch -c -w "static" -w "server" -w ".scripts" -s "cargo xfmt && node .scripts/build.mts && cargo build && clear && ./target/debug/onlytrades"
scripts.watch:win: cargo watch -c -w "static" -w "server" -w ".scripts" -s "cargo xfmt && node .scripts/build.mts && cargo build && cls && .\target\debug\onlytrades.exe"
scripts.watch:z: env APP_COMPRESS=true cargo watch -c -s "cargo xfmt && node .scripts/build.mts && cargo run"
